resolvedInSdk53.reason: Expo SDK 52 pins the affected archive library through its local CLI and cache tooling; a compatible patched version requires the coordinated Expo SDK upgrade.
resolvedInSdk53.mitigation: The package is not a direct application or Worker dependency. CI installs only the committed lockfile and processes trusted project/build inputs on ephemeral runners.
resolvedInSdk53.remediation: Upgrade Expo and React Native as one tested SDK set, remove this exception immediately when npm audit no longer reports it, and regenerate the release evidence.

exceptions.reason: React Native 0.79 pins image-size through Metro asset processing; the parser is used while building local assets and is not shipped as application logic.
exceptions.mitigation: Only repository-controlled image assets are processed, dependency installation is lockfile-pinned, and CI builds run on isolated ephemeral runners without untrusted uploads.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade the Expo and React Native SDK set to a Metro version with a patched image-size dependency, then delete this exception and rebuild all evidence.

exceptions.reason: Expo SDK 53 pins PostCSS through Metro configuration for local bundling; PraxisShield does not expose PostCSS as a production service or user-input parser.
exceptions.mitigation: Builds process repository-controlled CSS only, use the committed dependency lock, and execute on isolated runners without accepting attacker-controlled source maps.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade the coordinated Expo SDK toolchain to a patched PostCSS release, remove this exception immediately, and regenerate SBOM and release evidence.
